annotations.title: Search UK Contracts Finder & France BOAMP Public Tenders

description: Query UK Contracts Finder (OCDS) and France BOAMP government procurement tenders and contract awards with buyer contact emails, CPV codes, deadlines, GBP/EUR values, and awarded suppliers (`corridordata/uk-france-public-tenders-ocds`).

countries.description: Portals to query: UK (Contracts Finder), FR (BOAMP), or both.

maxItems.description: Maximum UK/French procurement notices to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

recordMode.description: Filter open tenders, awarded contracts, or all notices.

name: search_uk_france_tenders
